title: WebSocket Message Structure
description: Structure documentation for a WebSocket message as defined by RFC 6455. A message is composed of one or more frames with the same opcode.

fields.name: fin
fields.description: Final frame flag — true if this is the last fragment of a message

fields.name: masked
fields.description: Whether the payload is masked (required for client-to-server messages)

fields.name: payloadLength
fields.description: Length of the payload in bytes (7-bit, 16-bit, or 64-bit value)

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Frame payload data (UTF-8 text for text frames, binary for binary frames)

fields.name: rsv1
fields.description: Reserved bit 1 — used by extensions (e.g., permessage-deflate)

fields.name: rsv2
fields.description: Reserved bit 2 — reserved for future use

fields.name: rsv3
fields.description: Reserved bit 3 — reserved for future use
